# Scope : county 
# FACTOR : base factor conversion
# VARIANCE : randomization added to the base factor for each province
# CULTURE : culture to convert to
# FAITH : faith to convert to
E_kCAFG_county_randomized_invasion = {
    every_county_province = {
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
            name = randomized_invasion_factor_to_convert
            value = {
                fixed_range = {
                    min = {
                        value = $FACTOR$
                        subtract = {
                            fixed_range = {
                                min = 0
                                max = $VARIANCE$
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    max = {
                        value = $FACTOR$
                        add = {
                            fixed_range = {
                                min = 0
                                max = $VARIANCE$
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                min = 0
                max = 1
            }
        }

        E_kCAFG_province_weighted_culture_conversion = {
            FACTOR = scope:randomized_invasion_factor_to_convert
            CULTURE = $CULTURE$
        }
        # Instant tension drift
        set_variable = {
            name = kCAFG_culture_tension
            value = {
                value = var:kCAFG_culture_tension
                add = var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension
                divide = 2
            }
        }
        E_kCAFG_on_province_culture_tension_updated = yes

        E_kCAFG_province_weighted_faith_conversion = {
            FACTOR = scope:randomized_invasion_factor_to_convert
            FAITH = $FAITH$
        }
        # Instant tension drift
        set_variable = {
            name = kCAFG_faith_tension
            value = {
                value = var:kCAFG_faith_tension
                add = var:kCAFG_target_faith_tension
                divide = 2
            }
        }
        E_kCAFG_on_province_faith_tension_updated = yes
    }

    E_kCAFG_update_county_cultures_list = yes
    E_kCAFG_update_county_culture = { REASON = flag:kCAFG_invasion }
    
    E_kCAFG_update_county_faiths_list = yes
    E_kCAFG_update_county_faith = { REASON = flag:kCAFG_invasion }
}
